topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: When you told me about your job, I had no idea things were different from what you described. I guess I'm processing this news, trying to understand why you felt the need to present things in a certain light. It's a bit much to take in, and I find myself reflecting on our conversations, looking back at the details you shared. It's important to me that we can be open and honest with each other, and I hope we can talk this through. Maybe there's more to the story that I don't know yet, and I'm here to listen, to try to understand where you're coming from.
